result: In 36 CFS vs 36 controls on a 40-min tilt, postural tachycardia or (pre)syncope occurred in only a minority of CFS patients; supine HR was higher (66.4 vs 57.4 bpm) and tilt-negative patients showed a marked fall in stroke volume.
reason: Independent tilt cohort finding POTS/OI in a minority, matching the claim.
